verdict.rationale: Websets apply criteria and enrichment fields to every accepted item, up to a target item count, and send webhook callbacks as items are added or enriched. Exa Agent also covers entity enrichment and large-list building, and Contents takes multiple URLs. However, hands-on reports describe enrichment columns coming back empty and item verification stalling, and nothing documents general bulk actions such as batch editing, deleting or exporting items. Missing for 10: documented batch endpoints or limits for multi-item operations beyond list building and enrichment, generic bulk management actions on items, and independent confirmation that bulk enrichment works reliably at scale.
